# FC Bayern sending Arijon Ibrahimović out on loan to FC Augsburg

Read article contents Increase size

FC Bayern are sending Arijon Ibrahimović out on loan to FC Augsburg until the end of the season. The 20-year-old attacking player spent last season on loan at 1. FC Heidenheim

FC Bayern sporting director Christoph Freund: “We sat down with Arijon and agreed that it would be best for his development if we loaned him out for another season. He’s a young player with terrific potential and, at this stage, he needs to be playing regularly. He will do so at FC Augsburg, and we will continue to monitor him closely on this journey.”

Ibrahimović moved from 1. FC Nürnberg to the Bayern’s youth setup at the age of 12 and made his professional debut as a 17-year-old against VfL Bochum In February 2023. Following loan spells with Italian top-flight sides Frosinone Calcio and Lazio, Ibrahimović made 34 competitive appearances for Heidenheim last season (two goals, five assists). He has to date made two international appearances for the German Under-21 national team.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Arijon Ibrahimović to be part of Bayern Munich first-team in 2026/27

07.07.2026

### Summary

Image

Bayern Munich are planning to fully integrate Arijon Ibrahimović into Vincent Kompany's first-team squad for the 2026/27 campaign.

Ibrahimović, whose contract at Bayern runs until 30 June 2028, spent last season on loan at Heidenheim, where he registered two goals and five assists in 34 competitive appearances. 

That was enough to sway Kompany to give the 20-year-old a shot in the Bayern first-team pool for 2026/27.

"Arijon joined Bayern at the age of 12 and has made his way through our campus and targeted loan spells step by step," said sporting director Christoph Freund, referring to past stints in Seria A with Frosinone Calcio and Lazio.

Image: Arijon Ibrahimović was a first-team regular at Heidenheim in 2025/26. 

Arijon Ibrahimović was a first-team regular at Heidenheim in 2025/26. - DFL/Getty Images/Lukas Schulze

"He learned a great deal, especially during his very successful year in Heidenheim, which has prepared him for Bayern," Freund continued. "His development exemplifies the opportunities we offer our young talents. Now it's no longer just about learning for him – now it's about making his mark here."

Ibrahimović made his debut for Bayern in February 2023 as a second-half substitute in a 3-0 Bundesliga win over Bochum and has otherwise made three further cameo appearances for the record champions. 

A two-time Germany U21 international, Ibrahimović will now aim to get ready for Bayern's new season, which will kick off with the Franz Beckenbauer Supercup against Borussia Dortmund on 22 August.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Alexis Claude-Maurice signs for FC Augsburg

Contract until 2027

First Team 31.08.2024, 09:00

FCA have made a new signing in the shape of Alexis Claude-Maurice. The 26-year-old attacking midfield, who had a contract at OGC Nice until this summer, comes to Augsburg having played 102 Ligue 1 matches (ten goals, eleven assists). The Frenchman has signed a contract at FCA until 30th June 2027.

Having come through FC Lorient’s academy, Claude-Maurice joined Nice ahead of the 2019/20 season for a transfer fee of €13 million. He played 96 competitive games at the French top-division side, including six in the Europa League. The 26-year-old is at home both as a ten and an eight, and can also play on the wing.

## “Would like to help the team with good performances”

“After the end of my contract at Nice, I was on the look for an ambitious club where I can further my development as best of possible. The conversations with the leadership at FC Augsburg were incredibly positive and gave me the feeling that I am in the right place here. I am at a prime age now and would like to help the team with good performances and hopefully also with goals and assists so that we have a successful season,” said Alexis Claude-Maurice.

“Alexis brings a lot of experience from the top division in France and as a youth international. He can play across the frontline. With his technical qualities, his agility and his creativity, he should give our attacking play important impetus, especially in the final third,” explained FCA’s sporting director Marinko Jurendic.
